title: 第一卷 第6章 老朽出手，轻慑骄徒
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
赵山心中惊疑不定。

    他的炼气四层威压，就算对上普通炼气二层弟子，都能压得对方气息紊乱、双腿发软。

    可落在这百岁老者身上，竟如同石沉大海，毫无效果。

    “你当真引气入体成功了？”

    赵山沉声喝问，满脸难以置信。

    昨日他只当对方是勉强摸到门槛，虚有其表。

    可今日亲身施压，他才察觉不对劲。

    苏玄尘淡淡开口：

    “道无先后，达者为先。年岁高低，从不是修仙唯一凭据。”

    “可笑！”

    赵山怒极反笑。

    “老夫聊发少年狂？我看你是老糊涂了！”

    “百岁朽躯，经脉淤堵百年，根基烂得一塌糊涂！”

    “就算侥幸入了炼气一层，也是最弱最虚的垫底货色！”

    话音落下，赵山不再留手，身形一闪，抬手一掌径直拍向苏玄尘肩头。

    他没想重伤伤人。

    只为将这故作从容的老者狠狠推倒，打碎他的傲气，当众折辱。

    掌风凌厉，带着四层修士的力量。

    旁边两名弟子眼中立刻露出戏谑期待之色。

    下一刻，苏玄尘动了。

    百年凡人岁月，他虽无修为，却饱经世事，心性沉稳至极。

    面对骤然袭来的掌势，他不慌不忙，身形微微一侧。

    看似缓慢，却刚好卡在最精妙的时机。

    简简单单一步避让，轻松躲开赵山全力一掌。

    扑空的一瞬间，赵山脸色骤变。

    太快了！

    这身法从容精准，根本不像一个老朽能拥有的动静！

    不等他回神，苏玄尘枯瘦的手掌轻轻抬起。
content_en:
Zhao Shan was shocked and confused.

    His fourth-level Qi-refining pressure, even against an ordinary second-level Qi-refining disciple, can suppress the opponent's breath and make his legs weak.

    But when it fell on this hundred-year-old man, it was like a stone sinking into the sea, with no effect.

    "Did you really succeed in introducing Qi into your body?"

    Zhao Shan asked in a deep voice, his face full of disbelief.

    Yesterday, he only thought that the other party had barely touched the threshold and was only superficial.

    But today, after applying pressure in person, he realized something was wrong.

    Su Xuanchen said calmly:

    "There is no order of precedence, the master comes first. Age is never the only basis for cultivating immortality."

    "Ridiculous!"

    Zhao Shan laughed in anger.

    "I'm talking about being a teenager? I think you are an old fool!"

    "A hundred-year-old rotten body, a hundred-year-old meridians blocked, and a rotten foundation!"

    "Even if you are lucky enough to enter the first level of Qi Refining, you will still be the weakest and weakest at the bottom of the pile!"

    As soon as he finished speaking, Zhao Shan no longer held back his hand, and with a flash of his body, he raised his hand and slapped Su Xuanchen on the shoulder.

    He didn't mean to seriously hurt anyone.

    Just to push down the old man who was pretending to be calm, shatter his arrogance, and humiliate him in public.

    The palm wind was fierce, carrying the power of a fourth-level monk.

    The eyes of the two disciples next to him immediately showed a look of playful expectation.

    The next moment, Su Xuanchen moved.

    Although he has no cultivation in the hundred years of mortal life, he has experienced many things in the world and has an extremely calm mind.

    Facing the sudden palm attack, he remained calm and turned his body slightly to one side.

    It seems slow, but it happens to be stuck at the most exquisite timing.

    With a simple step of avoidance, he easily dodged Zhao Shan's full-strength palm.

    The moment he missed, Zhao Shan's expression suddenly changed.

    Too fast!

    This movement is calm and precise, not like the movement that an old man can have!

    Before he could recover, Su Xuanchen gently raised his skinny palm.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 6 The old man takes action to scare the arrogant
